name: ks-corporate-income-tax
description: Use this skill whenever asked about Kansas corporate income tax for tax year 2026 — the Form K-120 filing duty for corporations doing business in or deriving income from Kansas sources, automatic Subchapter S status for Kansas (banks excluded, they file the privilege tax), the repealed franchise tax, and federal-extension mechanics. Trigger on "Kansas corporate income tax", "K-120", "K-120S", "Kansas privilege tax banks", "KDOR corporate". Corrected 2026-10-28 against archived statute text: K.S.A. 79-32,110(c) normal tax 4% + surtax 3% over $50,000 (NOT a 12% bracket), no rate reduction for TY2026 per KDOR Notice 25-06.
